<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
	import type { SVGAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';
	import type { FsSize } from '../types';

	export type AvatarStatus = 'online' | 'busy' | 'away' | 'offline';
	export type AvatarShape = 'circle' | 'rounded' | 'square';

	interface Props extends SVGAttributes<SVGSVGElement> {
		src?: string;
		alt?: string;
		initials?: string;
		status?: AvatarStatus;
		/** Control height: sm 20 · md 24 · bs 28 · lg 32px */
		size?: FsSize;
		shape?: AvatarShape;
		class?: string;
		/** Rendered beside the avatar when there is no image or initials. */
		fallback?: Snippet;
	}

	let {
		src,
		alt = 'Avatar',
		initials,
		status,
		size = 'lg',
		shape = 'circle',
		class: className = '',
		fallback,
		...restProps
	}: Props = $props();

	let imgError = $state(false);
	const uid = $props.id();

	// fractalstyler has no avatar: the whole thing is one SVG, square by its
	// viewBox, sized by a control-height class, inked by text-* classes.
	const HEIGHT_CLASSES: Record<FsSize, string> = { sm: 'h-sm', md: 'h-md', bs: 'h-bs', lg: 'h-lg' };
	const STATUS_CLASSES: Record<AvatarStatus, string> = {
		online: 'text-success',
		busy: 'text-danger',
		away: 'text-warning',
		offline: 'text-muted'
	};
	const rx = $derived(shape === 'circle' ? 50 : shape === 'rounded' ? 12 : 0);
	const showImage = $derived(Boolean(src) && !imgError);
</script>

{#if !showImage && !initials && fallback}
	{@render fallback()}
{:else}
	<svg
		viewBox="0 0 100 100"
		class="shrink-0 {HEIGHT_CLASSES[size]} {className}"
		role="img"
		aria-label={status ? `${alt} (${status})` : alt}
		{...restProps}
	>
		<defs>
			<clipPath id="{uid}-clip"><rect width="100" height="100" {rx} /></clipPath>
		</defs>
		<g clip-path="url(#{uid}-clip)">
			<rect width="100" height="100" class="text-muted" fill="currentColor" opacity="0.35" />
			{#if showImage}
				<image
					href={src}
					width="100"
					height="100"
					preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"
					onerror={() => (imgError = true)}
				/>
			{:else if initials}
				<text
					x="50"
					y="50"
					text-anchor="middle"
					dominant-baseline="central"
					font-size="40"
					font-weight="600"
					class="text-primary"
					fill="currentColor">{initials.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}</text
				>
			{:else}
				<path
					class="text-secondary"
					fill="currentColor"
					d="M50 52c11 0 20-9 20-20s-9-20-20-20-20 9-20 20 9 20 20 20zm0 10c-13 0-40 7-40 20v18h80V82c0-13-27-20-40-20z"
				/>
			{/if}
		</g>
		{#if status}
			<circle cx="84" cy="84" r="13" class="text-inverse" fill="currentColor" />
			<circle cx="84" cy="84" r="9" class={STATUS_CLASSES[status]} fill="currentColor" />
		{/if}
	</svg>

components.name: BorderBeam
components.description: A dash of light travelling round its host’s border, drawn with an animated SVG stroke offset.

props.name: size
props.description: Beam length as a share of the perimeter (0–1)

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds per lap

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius in px, to match the host's rounding

components.code:
<script lang="ts">
	import type { SVGAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';
	import type { FsTone } from '../types';
	import { TONE_TEXT } from '../classes';

	interface Props extends SVGAttributes<SVGSVGElement> {
		/** Beam length as a share of the perimeter (0–1) */
		size?: number;
		/** Seconds per lap */
		duration?: number;
		tone?: FsTone;
		borderWidth?: number;
		/** Corner radius in px, to match the host's rounding */
		radius?: number;
		class?: string;
	}

	let {
		size = 0.2,
		duration = 6,
		tone = 'theme',
		borderWidth = 1.5,
		radius = 8,
		class: className = '',
		...restProps
	}: Props = $props();

	const beam = $derived(Math.max(1, Math.min(99, size * 100)));
	let w = $state(0);
	let h = $state(0);
	let svgEl = $state<SVGSVGElement | null>(null);

	$effect(() => {
		if (!svgEl) return;
		const ro = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {
			w = entry.contentRect.width;
			h = entry.contentRect.height;
		});
		ro.observe(svgEl);
		return () => ro.disconnect();
	});
</script>

<!-- Overlay for a padding-free .relative host: a dash of the border's own
     outline travels round it (stroke-dashoffset, animated by SMIL). -->
<svg bind:this={svgEl} class="absolute full {TONE_TEXT[tone]} {className}" pointer-events="none" aria-hidden="true" {...restProps}>
	{#if w > 0 && h > 0}
		<rect
			x={borderWidth / 2}
			y={borderWidth / 2}
			width={w - borderWidth}
			height={h - borderWidth}
			rx={radius}
			fill="none"
			stroke="currentColor"
			stroke-width={borderWidth}
			stroke-linecap="round"
			pathLength="100"
			stroke-dasharray="{beam} {100 - beam}"
		>
			<animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" from="100" to="0" dur="{duration}s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
		</rect>
	{/if}
</svg>

		'9': [14, 17, 17, 15, 1, 17, 14],

		G: [14, 17, 16, 23, 17, 17, 14],
		H: [17, 17, 17, 31, 17, 17, 17],
		I: [14, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 14],
		J: [7, 2, 2, 2, 2, 18, 12],
		K: [17, 18, 20, 24, 20, 18, 17],
		L: [16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 16, 31],
		M: [17, 27, 21, 21, 17, 17, 17],
		N: [17, 25, 21, 19, 17, 17, 17],
		O: [14, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 14],
		P: [30, 17, 17, 30, 16, 16, 16],
		Q: [14, 17, 17, 17, 21, 18, 13],
		R: [30, 17, 17, 30, 20, 18, 17],
		S: [14, 17, 16, 14, 1, 17, 14],
		T: [31, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4],
		U: [17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 14],
		V: [17, 17, 17, 17, 17, 10, 4],
		W: [17, 17, 17, 21, 21, 27, 17],
		X: [17, 17, 10, 4, 10, 17, 17],
		Y: [17, 17, 10, 4, 4, 4, 4],
		Z: [31, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 31],
		':': [0, 12, 12, 0, 12, 12, 0],
		'-': [0, 0, 0, 31, 0, 0, 0],
		'.': [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 12, 12],
		'!': [4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 0, 4]
	};

	interface Props extends SVGAttributes<SVGSVGElement> {
		text?: string;
		tone?: FsTone;
		glow?: boolean;
		/** Height of the display in em; width follows the character count. */
		height?: number;
		class?: string;
	}

	let {
		text = 'ONLINE',
		tone = 'success',
		glow = true,
		height = 1.5,
		class: className = '',
		...restProps
	}: Props = $props();

	const uid = $props.id();
	const chars = $derived((text || '').toUpperCase().split(''));
	// Each glyph is 5 dots + 1 gap wide; dots sit on a 1-unit grid.
	const cols = $derived(Math.max(1, chars.length * 6 - 1));

	const dots = $derived.by(() => {
		const out: { x: number; y: number; lit: boolean }[] = [];

	});

props.name: size

components.code:
<script lang="ts">
	import type { SVGAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';
	import type { FsTone } from '../types';
	import { TEXT_SIZE, TONE_TEXT, type FsTextSize } from '../classes';

	interface Props extends SVGAttributes<SVGSVGElement> {
		bars?: number;
		playing?: boolean;
		/** Bars are 1em tall at this text size */
		size?: FsTextSize;
		tone?: FsTone;
		class?: string;
	}

	let { bars = 5, playing = true, size = 'xl', tone = 'theme', class: className = '', ...restProps }: Props = $props();

	const count = $derived(Math.min(16, Math.max(3, bars)));
	// Staggered heights and periods so the bars never move in lockstep.
	const LEVELS = ['3;9;5;8;3', '8;4;9;3;8', '5;9;3;7;5', '9;5;7;4;9', '4;8;6;9;4'];
	const PERIODS = [0.85, 1.1, 0.75, 0.95, 1.2, 0.8, 1.05, 0.9, 1.15, 0.7];
</script>

<!-- Bars grow from the baseline: SMIL animates each rect's height and y. -->
<svg
	viewBox="0 0 {count * 3 - 1} 10"
	width="{(count * 3 - 1) / 10}em"
	height="1em"
	role="img"
	aria-label={playing ? 'Audio playing' : 'Audio paused'}
	class="shrink-0 {TEXT_SIZE[size]} {TONE_TEXT[tone]} {className}"
	{...restProps}
>
	{#each Array.from({ length: count }) as _, i (i)}
		{@const levels = LEVELS[i % LEVELS.length]}
		{#if playing}
			<rect x={i * 3} width="2" rx="1" fill="currentColor" y="5" height="5">
				<animate attributeName="height" values={levels} dur="{PERIODS[i % PERIODS.length]}s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
				<animate
					attributeName="y"
					values={levels.split(';').map((v) => 10 - Number(v)).join(';')}
					dur="{PERIODS[i % PERIODS.length]}s"
					repeatCount="indefinite"
				/>
			</rect>
		{:else}
			<rect x={i * 3} width="2" rx="1" fill="currentColor" y="8" height="2" />
		{/if}
	{/each}
</svg>

<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
	import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';
	import { WEIGHT, type FsWeight } from '../classes';

	export type HeadingLevel = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6;
	export type HeadingTag = 'h1' | 'h2' | 'h3' | 'h4' | 'h5' | 'h6' | 'span' | 'div';
	/** fractalstyler's heading roles, largest first */
	export type HeadingSize = 'display' | 'title' | 'xl' | 'lg' | 'bs' | 'md' | 'sm';
	export type HeadingTracking = 'tight' | 'normal' | 'wide';

	interface Props extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLHeadingElement> {
		level?: HeadingLevel;
		as?: HeadingTag;
		size?: HeadingSize;
		tracking?: HeadingTracking;
		weight?: FsWeight;
		class?: string;
		children?: Snippet;
	}

	let {
		level = 1,
		as,
		size,
		tracking = 'normal',
		weight,
		class: className = '',
		children,
		...restProps
	}: Props = $props();

	// The semantic composites carry size, weight, line-height and tracking
	// together (.page-title, .page-heading-*); the two small steps compose.
	const SIZE_CLASSES: Record<HeadingSize, string> = {
		display: 'hero-name lh11',
		title: 'page-title',
		xl: 'page-heading-xl',
		lg: 'page-heading-lg',
		bs: 'page-heading-bs',
		md: 'text-md weight-600 lh12',
		sm: 'text-sm weight-600 lh12 tt-u ls-wide-lg'
	};
	const TRACKING_CLASSES: Record<HeadingTracking, string> = {
		tight: 'ls-tight-lg',
		normal: '',

	};
	const BY_LEVEL: Record<HeadingLevel, HeadingSize> = { 1: 'title', 2: 'xl', 3: 'lg', 4: 'bs', 5: 'md', 6: 'sm' };

	const tag = $derived<HeadingTag>(as ?? (`h${level}` as HeadingTag));
	const sizeKey = $derived(size ?? BY_LEVEL[level]);

<script lang="ts">
	import type { SVGAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';
	import type { FsTone } from '../types';
	import { TONE_TEXT } from '../classes';

	interface Props extends Omit<SVGAttributes<SVGSVGElement>, 'fill'> {
		data: number[];
		/** Drawing size in px (the SVG's own coordinate box). */
		width?: number;
		height?: number;
		strokeWidth?: number;
		tone?: FsTone;
		fill?: boolean;
		class?: string;
	}

	let {
		data = [10, 25, 18, 30, 45, 38, 55, 62],
		width = 120,
		height = 36,
		strokeWidth = 2,
		tone = 'theme',
		fill = true,
		class: className = '',
		...restProps
	}: Props = $props();

	const uid = $props.id();

	const paths = $derived.by(() => {
		if (data.length < 2) return { line: '', area: '' };
		const min = Math.min(...data);
		const max = Math.max(...data);
		const range = max - min || 1;
		const pad = strokeWidth;
		const points = data.map((val, idx) => {
			const x = (idx / (data.length - 1)) * (width - pad * 2) + pad;
			const y = height - pad - ((val - min) / range) * (height - pad * 2);
			return `${x},${y}`;
		});
		const line = `M ${points.join(' L ')}`;
		return { line, area: `${line} L ${width - pad},${height} L ${pad},${height} Z` };
	});
</script>

components.name: Text
components.description: Body copy on the .text-body steps in body, lead, muted, subtle, caption, code and bold variants.
components.code:
<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from 'svelte';
	import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'svelte/elements';
	import { WEIGHT, type FsWeight } from '../classes';

	export type TextVariant = 'body' | 'lead' | 'muted' | 'subtle' | 'code' | 'caption' | 'bold';
	export type TextTag = 'p' | 'span' | 'div' | 'label' | 'small' | 'strong' | 'em';
	/** Body copy steps: .text-body-sm / .text-body / .text-body-lg */
	export type TextSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
	export type TextAlign = 'left' | 'center' | 'right';

	interface Props extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
		variant?: TextVariant;
		as?: TextTag;
		size?: TextSize;
		weight?: FsWeight;
		align?: TextAlign;
		truncate?: boolean;
		class?: string;
		children?: Snippet;
	}

	let {
		variant = 'body',
		as,
		size,
		weight,
		align,
		truncate = false,
		class: className = '',
		children,
		...restProps
	}: Props = $props();

	// Each variant pairs a body-copy step (line-height 1.5 built in) with ink.
	const VARIANT_CLASSES: Record<TextVariant, string> = {
		body: 'text-body text-primary',
		lead: 'text-body-lg text-secondary',
		muted: 'text-body-sm text-muted',
		subtle: 'text-body text-secondary',
		code: 'text-body-sm mono',
		caption: 'text-body-sm text-muted',
		bold: 'text-body weight-700'
	};
	const SIZE_CLASSES: Record<TextSize, string> = { sm: 'text-body-sm', md: 'text-body', lg: 'text-body-lg' };
	const ALIGN_CLASSES: Record<TextAlign, string> = { left: 'ta-l', center: 'ta-c', right: 'ta-r' };

	const tag = $derived<TextTag>(as ?? (variant === 'caption' ? 'small' : 'p'));
</script>

<svelte:element
	this={tag}
	class="{VARIANT_CLASSES[variant]} {size ? SIZE_CLASSES[size] : ''} {weight ? WEIGHT[weight] : ''} {align
		? ALIGN_CLASSES[align]
		: ''} {truncate ? 'truncate' : ''} {className}"
	{...restProps}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</svelte:element>

<script lang="ts">
	import { Icon } from 'fractalicons';
	import { luSun, luMoon } from 'fractalicons/lucide';
	import type { FsSize, FsVariant } from '../types';
	import { modeState } from '../mode.svelte';

	interface Props {
		variant?: FsVariant | 'iconbox';
		size?: FsSize;
		class?: string;
	}

	let { variant = 'ghost', size = 'lg', class: className = '' }: Props = $props();

	$effect(() => modeState.init());
</script>

<!-- Flips data-mode on <html>, which is all fractalstyler needs to swap token
     sets. The original's theme-style pills are gone: fractalstyler compiles a
     single palette, with no per-style hooks to switch. -->
<button
	type="button"
	class="frame-1-1 px-xs {className}"
	data-variant={variant}
	data-size={size}
	data-shape="modern"
	aria-label="Switch to {modeState.current === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'} mode"
	title="Switch to {modeState.current === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark'} mode"
	onclick={() => modeState.toggle()}
>
	<Icon icon={modeState.current === 'dark' ? luSun : luMoon} />
</button>
